name: Is cabinet refacing a good option for my kitchen remodel?
description: Refacing is ideal if your cabinet boxes are sound and you like your layout; otherwise, a full replacement may be better.

mainEntity.name: Is cabinet refacing a good option for my kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cabinet refacing is an excellent option if your existing cabinet boxes are in good structural condition and you are satisfied with your kitchen's current layout. It allows for a significant aesthetic upgrade without the higher cost and disruption associated with a complete demolition and rebuild. However, if you want to change your kitchen layout, add more cabinets, or if your current cabinet boxes are damaged, a full replacement might be more suitable. We can assess your current cabinets to help determine the best approach.
acceptedAnswer.description: Refacing is ideal if your cabinet boxes are sound and you like your layout; otherwise, a full replacement may be better.
